news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹984.4m (US$10.4m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.79 (vs ₹2.49 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.79 (up from ₹2.49 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹572.0m (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹25.8m (up 52% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.5% (up from 3.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 19% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 10% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
